component.name: Proton Pass session lock
component.summary: Lock and unlock the Proton Pass CLI session with a code

description.p: The Proton Pass CLI can gate an authenticated session behind a short lock code that re-arms itself after a configurable idle period. This is a tray icon and an unlock prompt for that lock, plus a small command line the same machine's scripts can call.
It is a front-end only: it runs the pass-cli binary and never holds a credential of its own. The lock code is read straight into pass-cli and dropped.
This is an unofficial project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Proton AG.
First release: the command line half, with the tray to follow.
